prompt: Research one AI compute, networking, and hyperscaler-monetisation investment idea.

inputs.seed_claim: AI spending is broadening from accelerators into networking, memory, lithography, foundry, cloud, and software, but winners must convert deployment into recurring revenue and free cash flow after power, depreciation, and competition.
inputs.drivers: Inference; sovereign AI; custom silicon; 800G and 1.6T networking; advanced nodes and packaging; cloud; power availability; enterprise-agent monetisation.
inputs.value_chain: Semiconductor equipment and foundries; networking; accelerators and edge chips; hyperscaler cloud; AI infrastructure operators; enterprise software.
inputs.supporting_evidence: The seed requires utilisation, pricing, and AI revenue to outgrow depreciation while networking, advanced-node, and software bottlenecks retain economics.
inputs.invalidation: Capex overbuild, custom silicon and competition compress returns, power delays deployment, export controls bind, or enterprise ROI remains weak.
